segments.src: ## Why the 10-year yield matters for mortgages
segments.tr: ## Why the 10-year yield matters for mortgages

segments.src: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate does not move in lockstep with the Federal Reserve's policy rate.
segments.tr: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate does not move in lockstep with the Federal Reserve's policy rate.

segments.src: It tends to track the 10-year Treasury yield instead.
segments.tr: It tends to track the 10-year Treasury yield instead.

segments.src: Investors who buy mortgage-backed securities compare the return on those bonds with the safe return on government debt.
segments.tr: Investors who buy mortgage-backed securities compare the return on those bonds with the safe return on government debt.

segments.src: Lenders then price home loans to deliver a return above that benchmark.
segments.tr: Lenders then price home loans to deliver a return above that benchmark.

segments.src: The gap between the two is called the mortgage spread.
segments.tr: The gap between the two is called the mortgage spread.

segments.src: In calmer periods it has historically averaged somewhere around 1.7 percentage points.
segments.tr: In calmer periods it has historically averaged somewhere around 1.7 percentage points.

segments.src: In recent years it has often been wider, because of interest-rate volatility and uncertainty about how quickly borrowers will refinance or move.
segments.tr: In recent years it has often been wider, because of interest-rate volatility and uncertainty about how quickly borrowers will refinance or move.

segments.src: A higher Treasury yield plus a wider spread means a higher mortgage rate, even if the central bank holds its policy rate steady.
segments.tr: A higher Treasury yield plus a wider spread means a higher mortgage rate, even if the central bank holds its policy rate steady.

segments.src: ## What is pushing yields up
segments.tr: ## What is pushing yields up

segments.src: Several forces tend to lift long-term yields at the same time:
segments.tr: Several forces tend to lift long-term yields at the same time:

segments.src: - **Heavy government borrowing.** Large federal deficits mean more Treasury debt for investors to absorb, which can push up the yield needed to attract buyers.
segments.tr: - **Heavy government borrowing.** Large federal deficits mean more Treasury debt for investors to absorb, which can push up the yield needed to attract buyers.

segments.src: - **Sticky inflation.** If price growth cools more slowly than expected, investors demand more compensation for holding long-term bonds.
segments.tr: - **Sticky inflation.** If price growth cools more slowly than expected, investors demand more compensation for holding long-term bonds.

segments.src: - **A "higher for longer" policy outlook.** When markets expect the Fed to keep rates elevated, longer-term yields adjust upward.
segments.tr: - **A "higher for longer" policy outlook.** When markets expect the Fed to keep rates elevated, longer-term yields adjust upward.

segments.src: - **A larger term premium.** Investors may ask for extra yield to cover the risk of holding long-dated debt amid economic and political uncertainty.
segments.tr: - **A larger term premium.** Investors may ask for extra yield to cover the risk of holding long-dated debt amid economic and political uncertainty.

segments.src: No single factor explains the move, and analysts disagree about how much weight each one deserves.
segments.tr: No single factor explains the move, and analysts disagree about how much weight each one deserves.

segments.src: ## The squeeze on buyers
segments.tr: ## The squeeze on buyers

segments.src: For buyers, the arithmetic is unforgiving.
segments.tr: For buyers, the arithmetic is unforgiving.

segments.tr: Consider a $400,000 loan on a 30-year fixed mortgage, counting principal and interest only:

segments.src: Going from 3% to 7% adds close to $1,000 a month on the same loan.
segments.tr: Going from 3% to 7% adds close to $1,000 a month on the same loan.

segments.src: Taxes, insurance and maintenance come on top of that.
segments.tr: Taxes, insurance and maintenance come on top of that.

segments.src: Many households that qualified comfortably a few years ago now find the numbers don't work, or they shop for a smaller home, a different neighborhood or a longer commute.
segments.tr: Many households that qualified comfortably a few years ago now find the numbers don't work, or they shop for a smaller home, a different neighborhood or a longer commute.

segments.src: Common responses among buyers include:
segments.tr: Common responses among buyers include:

segments.src: - **Rethinking the budget.** Some buyers now plan around the monthly payment instead of the headline price.
segments.tr: - **Rethinking the budget.** Some buyers now plan around the monthly payment instead of the headline price.

segments.src: - **Larger down payments.** Putting more money down reduces the loan amount and the interest paid over time.
segments.tr: - **Larger down payments.** Putting more money down reduces the loan amount and the interest paid over time.

segments.src: - **Adjustable-rate mortgages.** These offer lower initial rates but carry the risk of higher payments later. Borrowers should read the terms carefully.
segments.tr: - **Adjustable-rate mortgages.** These offer lower initial rates but carry the risk of higher payments later. Borrowers should read the terms carefully.

segments.src: - **Waiting.** Some renters are staying put until rates ease, though waiting has its own costs if prices or rents keep rising.
segments.tr: - **Waiting.** Some renters are staying put until rates ease, though waiting has its own costs if prices or rents keep rising.

segments.src: ## The "lock-in effect" and sellers
segments.tr: ## The "lock-in effect" and sellers

segments.src: Rates also affect the people who already own homes.
segments.tr: Rates also affect the people who already own homes.

segments.src: Millions of owners hold mortgages with rates far below today's levels.
segments.tr: Millions of owners hold mortgages with rates far below today's levels.

segments.src: Selling and buying again would mean swapping a cheap loan for an expensive one, so many choose to stay where they are.
segments.tr: Selling and buying again would mean swapping a cheap loan for an expensive one, so many choose to stay where they are.

segments.src: This is often called the lock-in effect.
segments.tr: This is often called the lock-in effect.

segments.src: It keeps the supply of existing homes for sale unusually low.
segments.tr: It keeps the supply of existing homes for sale unusually low.

segments.src: The result is a split market:
segments.tr: The result is a split market:

segments.src: - **Fewer listings** support prices in many areas, even though demand is weak.
segments.tr: - **Fewer listings** support prices in many areas, even though demand is weak.

segments.src: - **Longer time on market** for homes that are priced too high, which pushes some sellers to cut prices or offer concessions.
segments.tr: - **Longer time on market** for homes that are priced too high, which pushes some sellers to cut prices or offer concessions.

segments.src: - **Seller-paid incentives**, such as rate buydowns or help with closing costs, have become more common as a way to bring monthly payments down for buyers.
segments.tr: - **Seller-paid incentives**, such as rate buydowns or help with closing costs, have become more common as a way to bring monthly payments down for buyers.

segments.src: Sellers who must move for work, family or financial reasons face the toughest trade-offs.
segments.tr: Sellers who must move for work, family or financial reasons face the toughest trade-offs.

segments.src: They may need to price realistically and be flexible on terms.
segments.tr: They may need to price realistically and be flexible on terms.

segments.src: ## Pressure on builders
segments.tr: ## Pressure on builders

segments.src: Homebuilders feel the squeeze from both sides.
segments.tr: Homebuilders feel the squeeze from both sides.

segments.src: Higher mortgage rates cool demand.
segments.tr: Higher mortgage rates cool demand.

segments.src: Meanwhile, builders face their own borrowing costs for land and construction loans, along with the price of labor and materials.
segments.tr: Meanwhile, builders face their own borrowing costs for land and construction loans, along with the price of labor and materials.

segments.src: Because existing-home inventory is so tight, new construction has taken a larger share of the sales that do happen.
segments.tr: Because existing-home inventory is so tight, new construction has taken a larger share of the sales that do happen.

segments.src: Many builders have responded by:
segments.tr: Many builders have responded by:

segments.src: - offering mortgage rate buydowns or closing-cost credits,
segments.tr: - offering mortgage rate buydowns or closing-cost credits,

segments.src: - building smaller, more affordable floor plans,
segments.tr: - building smaller, more affordable floor plans,

segments.src: - slowing land purchases and new starts when demand softens.
segments.tr: - slowing land purchases and new starts when demand softens.

segments.src: If high rates persist, slower construction could limit future supply and keep housing costs elevated over the longer term, a trade-off that housing economists continue to debate.
segments.tr: If high rates persist, slower construction could limit future supply and keep housing costs elevated over the longer term, a trade-off that housing economists continue to debate.

segments.src: ## What it means for the broader economy
segments.tr: ## What it means for the broader economy

segments.src: Housing touches a large share of economic activity, from construction jobs and furniture sales to moving services and banking.
segments.tr: Housing touches a large share of economic activity, from construction jobs and furniture sales to moving services and banking.

segments.src: When transactions slow, those sectors feel it.
segments.tr: When transactions slow, those sectors feel it.

segments.src: Higher yields also raise borrowing costs for businesses and the government itself, which is one reason policymakers watch long-term rates closely.
segments.tr: Higher yields also raise borrowing costs for businesses and the government itself, which is one reason policymakers watch long-term rates closely.

segments.src: At the same time, higher yields are not all bad news.
segments.tr: At the same time, higher yields are not all bad news.

segments.src: Savers can earn more on Treasury securities, certificates of deposit and high-yield savings accounts.
segments.tr: Savers can earn more on Treasury securities, certificates of deposit and high-yield savings accounts.

segments.src: Those returns help offset higher costs for some households, particularly retirees who rely on interest income.
segments.tr: Those returns help offset higher costs for some households, particularly retirees who rely on interest income.

segments.src: ## Practical steps to consider
segments.tr: ## Practical steps to consider

segments.src: Every situation is different, but these general ideas come up often in consumer guidance:
segments.tr: Every situation is different, but these general ideas come up often in consumer guidance:

segments.src: 1. **Check your credit.** A higher score can qualify you for a better rate. Review your credit reports for errors before applying.
segments.tr: 1. **Check your credit.** A higher score can qualify you for a better rate. Review your credit reports for errors before applying.

segments.src: 2. **Compare lenders.** Quotes can differ meaningfully. Ask for a Loan Estimate from several lenders and compare both rates and fees.
segments.tr: 2. **Compare lenders.** Quotes can differ meaningfully. Ask for a Loan Estimate from several lenders and compare both rates and fees.

segments.src: 3. **Understand the total cost.** Look at points, closing costs and insurance, not just the interest rate.
segments.tr: 3. **Understand the total cost.** Look at points, closing costs and insurance, not just the interest rate.

segments.src: 4. **Ask about refinancing later.** If you buy now and rates fall, you may be able to refinance, but there is no guarantee. Check for fees and make sure the savings justify the cost.
segments.tr: 4. **Ask about refinancing later.** If you buy now and rates fall, you may be able to refinance, but there is no guarantee. Check for fees and make sure the savings justify the cost.

segments.src: 5. **Keep a cushion.** Make sure you can afford the payment and still have emergency savings.
segments.tr: 5. **Keep a cushion.** Make sure you can afford the payment and still have emergency savings.

segments.src: 6. **Talk to a professional.** A housing counselor, mortgage officer or financial adviser can help you weigh your options. HUD-approved housing counselors offer free or low-cost guidance in the United States.
segments.tr: 6. **Talk to a professional.** A housing counselor, mortgage officer or financial adviser can help you weigh your options. HUD-approved housing counselors offer free or low-cost guidance in the United States.

segments.src: ## What to watch this fall
segments.tr: ## What to watch this fall

segments.src: - **Inflation reports.** Cooler readings could ease pressure on yields. Hotter ones could add to it.
segments.tr: - **Inflation reports.** Cooler readings could ease pressure on yields. Hotter ones could add to it.

segments.src: - **Federal Reserve meetings.** Statements about the future path of rates often move the bond market.
segments.tr: - **Federal Reserve meetings.** Statements about the future path of rates often move the bond market.

segments.src: - **Treasury auctions and deficit news.** Demand for government debt influences yields.
segments.tr: - **Treasury auctions and deficit news.** Demand for government debt influences yields.

segments.src: - **Existing-home sales and builder sentiment.** These show whether buyers are adapting or pulling back.
segments.tr: - **Existing-home sales and builder sentiment.** These show whether buyers are adapting or pulling back.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## The bottom line

segments.src: A 10-year Treasury yield above 5% is a reminder that mortgage rates are shaped by forces well beyond any one lender or homebuyer.
segments.tr: A 10-year Treasury yield above 5% is a reminder that mortgage rates are shaped by forces well beyond any one lender or homebuyer.

segments.src: For now, elevated yields are keeping borrowing costs high, holding many owners in place and testing builders' margins.
segments.tr: For now, elevated yields are keeping borrowing costs high, holding many owners in place and testing builders' margins.

segments.src: No one can say for sure when conditions will change, and forecasts have a mixed record.
segments.tr: No one can say for sure when conditions will change, and forecasts have a mixed record.

segments.src: The most useful approach for most households is to focus on what they can control: their budget, their credit and their time horizon.
segments.tr: The most useful approach for most households is to focus on what they can control: their budget, their credit and their time horizon.

us-20261004-news-2.title: Empat Minggu Menjelang Hari Pemilihan: Medan Pertempuran Senat yang Akan Menentukan Kendali Majelis

segments.src: With four weeks left until Election Day on November 3, the fight for control of the U.S.
segments.tr: Dengan empat minggu tersisa hingga Hari Pemilihan pada 3 November, pertarungan untuk mengendalikan

segments.src: Senate has narrowed to a handful of competitive contests.
segments.tr: Senat AS telah menyempit menjadi segelintir kontes yang kompetitif.

segments.src: Republicans currently hold a 53–47 majority, which means Democrats need a net gain of four seats to win outright.
segments.tr: Partai Republik saat ini memegang mayoritas 53–47, yang berarti Partai Demokrat membutuhkan perolehan bersih empat kursi untuk menang secara langsung.

segments.src: They would need only three if they also held the vice presidency, since the vice president breaks tie votes.
segments.tr: Mereka hanya membutuhkan tiga kursi jika mereka juga memegang jabatan wakil presiden, karena wakil presiden memecah kebuntuan suara.

segments.src: That is a steep climb, and it runs through several states that President Donald Trump carried comfortably in 2024.
segments.tr: Itu adalah pendakian yang curam, dan itu melewati beberapa negara bagian yang dimenangkan Presiden Donald Trump dengan nyaman pada 2024.

segments.src: This overview looks at the states most likely to decide the outcome, what is driving each race, and how two national issues, the economy and the war involving Iran, are shaping the closing arguments.
segments.tr: Tinjauan ini melihat negara bagian yang paling mungkin menentukan hasil, apa yang mendorong setiap perlombaan, dan bagaimana dua masalah nasional, ekonomi dan perang yang melibatkan Iran, membentuk argumen penutup.

segments.src: Race ratings and polls shift often, so treat this as a map of the terrain rather than a forecast.
segments.tr: Peringkat perlombaan dan jajak pendapat sering berubah, jadi anggap ini sebagai peta medan daripada ramalan.

segments.src: ## The Math Behind the Map
segments.tr: ## Matematika di Balik Peta

segments.src: Democrats have to defend their own competitive seats and also flip several Republican-held ones.
segments.tr: Partai Demokrat harus mempertahankan kursi kompetitif mereka sendiri dan juga membalikkan beberapa kursi yang dipegang Partai Republik.

segments.src: Republicans, for their part, are trying to protect a cushion built in the last two cycles while defending seats in states that are more competitive than their recent partisan history suggests.
segments.tr: Partai Republik, di sisi lain, mencoba melindungi bantalan yang dibangun dalam dua siklus terakhir sambil mempertahankan kursi di negara bagian yang lebih kompetitif daripada yang disarankan oleh sejarah partisan mereka baru-baru ini.

segments.src: Analysts generally sort the map into three tiers:
segments.tr: Analis umumnya membagi peta menjadi tiga tingkatan:

segments.src: - **Core battlegrounds:** Georgia, Michigan, North Carolina and Maine.
segments.tr: - **Medan pertempuran inti:** Georgia, Michigan, North Carolina, dan Maine.

segments.src: - **Reach states for Democrats:** Ohio, Texas, Iowa and Alaska.
segments.tr: - **Negara bagian jangkauan untuk Demokrat:** Ohio, Texas, Iowa, dan Alaska.

segments.src: - **Seats to watch on defense:** New Hampshire and Minnesota, where open seats have kept Republicans hopeful.
segments.tr: - **Kursi yang perlu diperhatikan dalam pertahanan:** New Hampshire dan Minnesota, di mana kursi terbuka membuat Partai Republik tetap berharap.

segments.tr: ### Georgia

segments.tr: Jon Ossoff sedang mencari masa jabatan kedua di negara bagian yang dimenangkan Trump pada 2024.

segments.src: Ossoff has leaned on his fundraising advantage and a message focused on health care costs and local issues.
segments.tr: Partai Republik berpendapat bahwa pemilih tidak senang dengan harga dan menginginkan perubahan.

segments.tr: Tingkat partisipasi di pinggiran kota Atlanta, dan di antara pemilih Kulit Hitam dan pemilih yang lebih muda, kemungkinan akan menentukan hasilnya.

segments.src: Turnout in the Atlanta suburbs, and among Black voters and younger voters, will likely decide the outcome.

segments.src: Gary Peters is retiring, leaving an open seat in a state that has swung narrowly in recent elections.
segments.tr: Michigan adalah ujian klasik tentang pesan ekonomi partai mana yang mendarat dengan pemilih kelas pekerja dan pinggiran kota.

segments.src: Michigan is a classic test of which party's economic message lands with working-class and suburban voters.
segments.tr: Manufaktur, kebijakan perdagangan, pekerjaan industri otomotif, dan biaya hidup adalah tema utama.

segments.src: Manufacturing, trade policy, auto-industry jobs and the cost of living are central themes.
segments.tr: Kedua partai melihat negara bagian itu sebagai negara yang bisa dimenangkan.

segments.src: Both parties see the state as winnable.

segments.src: Republicans have held the state in presidential contests, but it has a history of close statewide races and split-ticket voting.
segments.tr: Partai Demokrat percaya kandidat terkenal dengan daya tarik lintas partai memberi mereka peluang nyata.

segments.src: Democrats believe a well-known candidate with crossover appeal gives them a real opening.
segments.tr: Partai Republik mengandalkan kecenderungan negara bagian dalam perlombaan federal dan partisipasi di daerah pedesaan.

segments.src: Susan Collins is the only Republican senator representing a state that Kamala Harris carried in 2024, and she has built a long record of winning by running ahead of her party.
segments.tr: Tantangannya adalah bahwa perlombaan Senat telah menjadi lebih dinasionalisasi dan pemisahan tiket lebih jarang terjadi daripada sebelumnya.

segments.src: Her challenge is that Senate races have become more nationalized and ticket-splitting is rarer than it used to be.
segments.tr: Partai Demokrat berharap frustrasi nasional menarik pemilih Maine ke arah calon mereka, sementara Collins menekankan kemandiriannya dan rekornya dalam memberikan hasil bagi negara bagian.

segments.src: Democrats are hoping national frustration pulls Maine voters toward their nominee, while Collins is stressing her independence and her record of delivering for the state.
segments.tr: ## Negara Bagian Jangkauan

segments.src: ## The Reach States
segments.tr: Partai Demokrat melihat beberapa peluang yang lebih sulit, dan salah satunya bisa mengubah matematika:

segments.src: Democrats see several longer-shot opportunities, and any one of them could change the math:
segments.tr: - **Ohio:** Pemilihan khusus untuk kursi yang dipegang oleh petahana Republik yang ditunjuk, Senator Jon Husted, telah menarik penantang Demokrat profil tinggi di mantan Senator Sherrod Brown. Ohio telah cenderung ke Partai Republik dalam siklus baru-baru ini, jadi pertanyaannya adalah apakah merek Brown dapat mengatasi hal itu.

segments.src: - **Ohio:** A special election for a seat held by an appointed Republican incumbent, Sen. Jon Husted, has drawn a high-profile Democratic challenger in former Sen. Sherrod Brown. Ohio has trended Republican in recent cycles, so the question is whether Brown's brand can overcome that.
segments.tr: - **Texas:** Negara bagian ini tetap condong ke Partai Republik, tetapi lingkungan yang kompetitif dan pengeluaran besar telah menempatkannya di daftar pantauan. Ukurannya membuatnya mahal bagi kedua belah pihak.

segments.src: - **Texas:** The state remains Republican-leaning, but a competitive environment and heavy spending have put it on the watch list. Its size makes it expensive for both sides.
segments.tr: - **Iowa:** Senator Joni Ernst tidak mencalonkan diri lagi, meninggalkan kursi terbuka di negara bagian yang telah bergerak ke kanan tetapi di mana ekonomi pertanian dan perdagangan adalah masalah sensitif.

segments.src: - **Iowa:** Sen. Joni Ernst is not running again, leaving an open seat in a state that has moved to the right but where farm economics and trade are sensitive issues.
segments.tr: - **Alaska:** Senator Dan Sullivan mempertahankan kursinya di negara bagian dengan kecenderungan independen yang kuat dan sistem pemungutan suara peringkat-pilihan yang dapat memberi penghargaan kepada kandidat dengan daya tarik luas.

segments.src: - **Alaska:** Sen. Dan Sullivan is defending his seat in a state with a strong independent streak and a ranked-choice voting system that can reward candidates with broad appeal.
segments.tr: Partai Republik juga memiliki target mereka sendiri, termasuk kursi terbuka yang dipegang Demokrat di New Hampshire dan Minnesota, meskipun Demokrat memulai dengan keunggulan di keduanya.

segments.src: Republicans have their own targets as well, including open Democratic-held seats in New Hampshire and Minnesota, though Democrats begin with an edge in both.
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana Ekonomi Membentuk Argumen Penutup

segments.src: ## How the Economy Is Shaping the Closing Argument
segments.tr: Kekhawatiran ekonomi adalah tema dominan di hampir setiap kontes.

segments.src: Economic concerns are the dominant theme in nearly every contest.
segments.tr: Pemilih terus mengutip biaya bahan makanan, perumahan, asuransi, dan energi sebagai kekhawatiran utama, dan peringkat persetujuan presiden mengenai ekonomi telah menjadi beban bagi partainya dalam banyak survei.

segments.src: Voters continue to cite the cost of groceries, housing, insurance and energy as top worries, and the president's approval ratings on the economy have been a drag on his party in many surveys.
segments.tr: - **Partai Demokrat** menekan pesan tentang keterjangkauan, biaya perawatan kesehatan, dan efek tarif pada anggaran rumah tangga dan usaha kecil.

segments.src: - **Democrats** are pressing a message about affordability, health care costs and the effects of tariffs on household budgets and small businesses.
segments.tr: - **Partai Republik** menunjuk pada kebijakan pajak, deregulasi, dan produksi energi, dan mereka berpendapat bahwa Demokrat akan membalikkan kemajuan yang mereka klaim telah dibuat.

segments.src: - **Republicans** are pointing to tax policy, deregulation and energy production, and they argue that Democrats would reverse the progress they claim to have made.
segments.tr: Karena kandidat Senat mencalonkan diri pada surat suara yang sama dengan puncak lingkungan politik nasional, pandangan publik tentang ekonomi cenderung lebih penting daripada masalah lokal tunggal mana pun.

segments.src: Because Senate candidates run on the same ballot as the top of the national political environment, the public's view of the economy tends to matter more than any single local issue.
segments.tr: ## Perang Iran Memasuki Kampanye

segments.src: ## The Iran War Enters the Campaign
segments.tr: Kebijakan luar negeri jarang menentukan perlombaan Senat, tetapi konflik yang melibatkan Iran telah menjadi bagian dari debat penutup.

segments.src: Foreign policy rarely decides Senate races, but the conflict involving Iran has become part of the closing debate.
segments.tr: Masalah ini menyentuh beberapa tema sekaligus: harga bahan bakar dan energi, penggunaan kekuatan militer dan pengawasan kongres, biaya bagi pembayar pajak, dan kepedulian terhadap anggota layanan dan keluarga mereka.

segments.src: The issue touches several themes at once: fuel and energy prices, the use of military force and congressional oversight, the cost to taxpayers, and concern for service members and their families.
segments.tr: Kandidat menggunakan konflik dengan cara yang berbeda.

segments.src: Candidates are using the conflict in different ways.
segments.tr: Beberapa menekankan keamanan nasional dan dukungan untuk militer, sementara yang lain menyerukan strategi yang lebih jelas, otorisasi kongres yang lebih kuat, dan transparansi yang lebih besar.

segments.src: Some emphasize national security and support for the military, while others call for a clearer strategy, stronger congressional authorization and more transparency.
segments.tr: Di negara bagian dengan komunitas militer yang besar, seperti Georgia, North Carolina, dan Alaska, debat ini memiliki bobot khusus.

segments.src: In states with large military communities, such as Georgia, North Carolina and Alaska, the debate carries particular weight.
segments.tr: Efek politiknya akan bergantung pada bagaimana peristiwa berlangsung dalam beberapa minggu mendatang, terutama jika harga energi bergerak tajam.

segments.src: Its political effect will depend on how events unfold in the coming weeks, especially if energy prices move sharply.
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Harus Diperhatikan dalam Empat Minggu Terakhir

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the Final Four Weeks
segments.tr: 1. **Pemungutan suara awal dan surat suara melalui pos.** Banyak negara bagian memulai pemungutan suara awal bulan ini, jadi pola partisipasi akan menawarkan petunjuk jauh sebelum Hari Pemilihan.

segments.src: 1. **Early voting and mail ballots.** Many states begin early voting this month, so turnout patterns will offer clues well before Election Day.
segments.tr: 2. **Debat kandidat.** Untuk perlombaan yang berimbang, kinerja debat tunggal dapat menggeser pemilih yang belum memutuskan.

segments.src: 2. **Candidate debates.** For closely matched races, a single debate performance can shift undecided voters.
segments.tr: 3. **Pengeluaran luar.** Super PAC dan komite partai diharapkan menuangkan puluhan juta dolar ke sejumlah kecil negara bagian, dan ke mana uang itu pergi menunjukkan di mana setiap partai melihat peluang terbaiknya.

segments.src: 3. **Outside spending.** Super PACs and party committees are expected to pour tens of millions of dollars into a small number of states, and where that money goes shows where each party sees its best chances.
segments.tr: 4. **Pemisahan tiket.** Apakah pemilih memilih partai yang berbeda untuk politik era presiden dan untuk senator mereka, seperti di Maine, mungkin lebih penting daripada yang disarankan jajak pendapat.

segments.src: 4. **Ticket-splitting.** Whether voters choose different parties for president-era politics and for their senator, as in Maine, may matter more than polls suggest.
segments.tr: 5. **Waktu penghitungan.** Beberapa negara bagian menghitung surat suara melalui pos secara perlahan, jadi jawaban akhir tentang kendali majelis bisa memakan waktu berhari-hari. Setiap putaran kedua, seperti yang disyaratkan aturan Georgia ketika tidak ada kandidat yang mencapai mayoritas, dapat memperpanjang garis waktu.

segments.src: 5. **Counting time.** Some states count mail ballots slowly, so the final answer on control of the chamber could take days. Any runoff, such as Georgia's rules require when no candidate reaches a majority, could extend the timeline.
segments.tr: ## Intinya

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: Partai Demokrat memiliki jalan menuju mayoritas, tetapi itu mengharuskan mempertahankan setiap kursi kompetitif mereka sendiri dan memenangkan setidaknya dua atau tiga negara bagian yang condong ke Partai Republik.

segments.src: Democrats have a path to a majority, but it requires holding every competitive seat of their own and winning at least two or three states that lean Republican.
segments.tr: Partai Republik memiliki keuntungan dari peta awal tetapi mempertahankan beberapa kursi terbuka di lingkungan yang lebih sulit bagi partai yang berkuasa.

segments.src: Republicans have the advantage of the starting map but are defending several open seats in an environment that has been tougher for the party in power.
segments.tr: Dengan perlombaan yang begitu ketat, pergeseran beberapa poin persentase di hanya beberapa negara bagian dapat menentukan siapa yang mengendalikan Senat selama dua tahun ke depan.

segments.src: With the races this close, a shift of a few percentage points in just a few states could decide who controls the Senate for the next two years.
segments.tr: *Artikel ini untuk tujuan informasi umum dan tidak mendukung kandidat atau partai mana pun.

us-20261004-news-3.title: Musim Laporan Keuangan Dimulai: Apa yang Bisa Diungkapkan oleh Laporan Bank Besar tentang Konsumen Amerika

segments.src: Third-quarter earnings season is about to begin, and the first reports will come from the country's largest lenders.
segments.tr: Musim laporan laba kuartal ketiga akan segera dimulai, dan laporan pertama akan datang dari pemberi pinjaman terbesar di negara ini.

segments.src: Investors usually watch these results for profit figures.
segments.tr: Investor biasanya mengamati hasil ini untuk melihat angka-angka laba.

segments.src: This quarter they will also read them as a check on household finances, because the banks see how millions of Americans borrow, spend and repay.
segments.tr: Kuartal ini mereka juga akan membacanya sebagai ukuran keuangan rumah tangga, karena bank melihat bagaimana jutaan warga Amerika meminjam, membelanjakan, dan membayar kembali uang mereka.

segments.src: ## Why Bank Earnings Matter Beyond Wall Street
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Laporan Keuangan Bank Penting di Luar Wall Street

segments.src: Large banks sit at the center of consumer finance.
segments.tr: Bank-bank besar berada di pusat keuangan konsumen.

segments.src: They issue credit cards, make auto and home loans, and process a large share of daily card payments.
segments.tr: Mereka menerbitkan kartu kredit, memberikan pinjaman mobil dan rumah, serta memproses sebagian besar pembayaran kartu harian.

segments.src: Their quarterly reports, and the commentary from executives on calls with analysts, offer a broad view of how households are doing.
segments.tr: Laporan kuartalan mereka, dan komentar dari para eksekutif dalam panggilan dengan analis, menawarkan pandangan luas tentang kondisi rumah tangga.

segments.src: That view is more current than many government statistics, which often arrive with a delay.
segments.tr: Pandangan tersebut lebih mutakhir daripada banyak statistik pemerintah, yang sering kali datang dengan keterlambatan.

segments.src: This quarter's question is whether consumers are managing under high interest rates and elevated prices.
segments.tr: Pertanyaan kuartal ini adalah apakah konsumen mampu mengelola keuangan di tengah suku bunga yang tinggi dan harga yang naik.

segments.src: Borrowing costs have stayed high for a long time, and the price of groceries, housing and insurance remains well above where it stood a few years ago.
segments.tr: Biaya pinjaman tetap tinggi untuk waktu yang lama, dan harga bahan makanan, perumahan, serta asuransi tetap berada jauh di atas harga beberapa tahun lalu.

segments.src: Banks' own data should show how much strain that has caused.
segments.tr: Data dari bank sendiri seharusnya menunjukkan seberapa besar tekanan yang ditimbulkan hal tersebut.

segments.src: ## Three Things Investors Will Be Watching
segments.tr: ## Tiga Hal yang Akan Diamati oleh Investor

segments.src: ### 1. Loan Defaults and Charge-Offs
segments.tr: ### 1. Gagal Bayar Pinjaman dan Penghapusan Buku

segments.src: The first area is credit quality.
segments.tr: Area pertama adalah kualitas kredit.

segments.src: Analysts will look at **delinquency rates**, meaning the share of borrowers who have fallen behind on payments.
segments.tr: Analis akan melihat **delinquency rates**, yang berarti porsi peminjam yang telah tertinggal dalam pembayaran.

segments.src: They will also look at **net charge-offs**, meaning the debts a bank has given up on collecting.
segments.tr: Mereka juga akan melihat **net charge-offs**, yang berarti utang yang telah dilepaskan oleh bank untuk ditagih.

segments.src: Rising numbers here would suggest that some households are running out of room.
segments.tr: Angka yang meningkat di sini akan menyarankan bahwa beberapa rumah tangga mulai kehabisan ruang gerak.

segments.src: A stable or improving trend would support the view that the consumer is holding up.
segments.tr: Tren yang stabil atau membaik akan mendukung pandangan bahwa konsumen masih bertahan.

segments.src: Investors will also check how much money banks have set aside as a cushion for future losses, known as **loan-loss provisions**.
segments.tr: Investor juga akan memeriksa berapa banyak uang yang telah disisihkan oleh bank sebagai bantalan untuk kerugian masa depan, yang dikenal sebagai **loan-loss provisions**.

segments.src: A bank that increases its reserves is signaling more caution about what comes next.
segments.tr: Bank yang meningkatkan cadangannya menandakan kehati-hatian yang lebih besar tentang apa yang akan terjadi selanjutnya.

segments.src: ### 2. Credit Card Balances
segments.tr: ### 2. Saldo Kartu Kredit

segments.src: Credit card debt is a key indicator of household stress.
segments.tr: Utang kartu kredit adalah indikator utama tekanan rumah tangga.

segments.src: Balances have grown over the past several years, and card interest rates are high.
segments.tr: Saldo telah tumbuh selama beberapa tahun terakhir, dan suku bunga kartu kredit tinggi.

segments.src: Analysts will compare balance growth with the pace of spending to judge whether people are borrowing for convenience or because they need to cover everyday costs.
segments.tr: Analis akan membandingkan pertumbuhan saldo dengan kecepatan pengeluaran untuk menilai apakah orang meminjam demi kenyamanan atau karena mereka perlu menutupi biaya sehari-hari.

segments.src: Payment behavior matters as well.
segments.tr: Perilaku pembayaran juga penting.

segments.src: If more cardholders are paying only the minimum, or if late payments are increasing, that can be an early sign of trouble.
segments.tr: Jika lebih banyak pemegang kartu hanya membayar minimum, atau jika keterlambatan pembayaran meningkat, itu bisa menjadi tanda awal masalah.

segments.src: Lenders often say which income groups are driving these trends, and those comments can be informative.
segments.tr: Pemberi pinjaman sering kali mengatakan kelompok pendapatan mana yang mendorong tren ini, dan komentar tersebut dapat memberikan informasi yang berguna.

segments.src: ### 3. Consumer Spending Patterns
segments.tr: ### 3. Pola Pengeluaran Konsumen

segments.src: Banks also report how much customers are spending on debit and credit cards.
segments.tr: Bank juga melaporkan berapa banyak yang dibelanjakan pelanggan pada kartu debit dan kredit.

segments.src: This gives a near real-time reading on the economy, since consumer spending accounts for roughly two-thirds of U.S.
segments.tr: Ini memberikan pembacaan yang hampir waktu nyata (real-time) tentang ekonomi, karena pengeluaran konsumen menyumbang sekitar dua pertiga dari kegiatan

segments.src: economic activity.
segments.tr: ekonomi U.S.

segments.src: Analysts will look at whether spending is broad-based or concentrated among higher-income households.
segments.tr: Analis akan melihat apakah pengeluaran berbasis luas atau terkonsentrasi di kalangan rumah tangga berpendapatan lebih tinggi.

segments.src: In recent quarters, some lenders have described a "two-speed" consumer.
segments.tr: Dalam beberapa kuartal terakhir, beberapa pemberi pinjaman telah menggambarkan konsumen "dua kecepatan".

segments.src: Wealthier households continue to spend on travel and dining, while lower- and middle-income households are more careful and look for deals.
segments.tr: Rumah tangga yang lebih kaya terus menghabiskan uang untuk perjalanan dan makan di luar, sementara rumah tangga berpendapatan rendah dan menengah lebih berhati-hati dan mencari penawaran diskon.

segments.src: Executives' remarks on this split are likely to draw attention.
segments.tr: Pernyataan para eksekutif mengenai perpecahan ini kemungkinan besar akan menarik perhatian.

segments.src: ## Other Factors in the Picture
segments.tr: ## Faktor Lain dalam Gambaran Tersebut

segments.src: Bank profits depend on more than consumer behavior.
segments.tr: Keuntungan bank bergantung pada lebih dari sekadar perilaku konsumen.

segments.src: Several other themes may come up in this round of reports:
segments.tr: Beberapa tema lain mungkin muncul dalam putaran laporan ini:

segments.src: - **Net interest income:** The gap between what banks earn on loans and what they pay on deposits. Changes in interest rates affect this figure.
segments.tr: - **Net interest income:** Selisih antara apa yang diperoleh bank dari pinjaman dan apa yang mereka bayar untuk simpanan. Perubahan suku bunga memengaruhi angka ini.

segments.src: - **Investment banking and trading:** Revenue from deal-making and markets can offset weakness elsewhere.
segments.tr: - **Investment banking dan trading:** Pendapatan dari pembuatan kesepakatan dan pasar dapat mengimbangi kelemahan di tempat lain.

segments.src: - **Commercial real estate:** Some lenders still face questions about office properties and other commercial loans.
segments.tr: - **Commercial real estate:** Beberapa pemberi pinjaman masih menghadapi pertanyaan tentang properti kantor dan pinjaman komersial lainnya.

segments.src: - **The labor market:** Job security is the main support for household finances. Executives' comments on employment trends among their customers can shape how investors read the results.
segments.tr: - **Pasar tenaga kerja:** Keamanan kerja adalah dukungan utama bagi keuangan rumah tangga. Komentar para eksekutif tentang tren ketenagakerjaan di kalangan pelanggan mereka dapat membentuk cara investor membaca hasil.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Results
segments.tr: ## Cara Membaca Hasil

segments.src: A single quarter rarely settles the debate.
segments.tr: Satu kuartal saja jarang menyelesaikan perdebatan.

segments.src: Some tips for making sense of the headlines:
segments.tr: Beberapa tip untuk memahami berita utama:

segments.src: 1. **Look at trends, not one number.** Compare results with prior quarters and with the same period a year ago.
segments.tr: 1. **Lihat trennya, bukan hanya satu angka.** Bandingkan hasil dengan kuartal sebelumnya dan dengan periode yang sama tahun lalu.

segments.src: 2. **Pay attention to the tone of management.** Words such as "resilient," "normalizing" or "cautious" can signal how executives see the months ahead.
segments.tr: **Perhatikan nada manajemen.** Kata-kata seperti "resilient," "normalizing" atau "cautious" dapat menandakan bagaimana para eksekutif melihat bulan-bulan mendatang.

segments.src: 3. **Compare across banks.** Lenders serve different customers, so differences between them can reveal where stress is building.
segments.tr: 3. **Bandingkan antar bank.** Pemberi pinjaman melayani pelanggan yang berbeda, jadi perbedaan di antara mereka dapat mengungkapkan di mana tekanan sedang menumpuk.

segments.src: 4. **Remember the limits.** Bank data covers their own customers and may not represent every household.
segments.tr: 4. **Ingatlah batasannya.** Data bank mencakup pelanggan mereka sendiri dan mungkin tidak mewakili setiap rumah tangga.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Everyday Households
segments.tr: ## Apa Artinya bagi Rumah Tangga Sehari-hari

segments.src: For people outside the investing world, these reports are still a useful guide.
segments.tr: Bagi orang di luar dunia investasi, laporan ini tetap menjadi panduan yang berguna.

segments.src: They can indicate whether credit may become harder to get, whether lenders expect more borrowers to struggle, and how companies see the strength of the economy.
segments.tr: Mereka dapat menunjukkan apakah kredit mungkin menjadi lebih sulit didapat, apakah pemberi pinjaman mengharapkan lebih banyak peminjam untuk berjuang, dan bagaimana perusahaan melihat kekuatan ekonomi.

segments.src: If banks report rising defaults and tighter lending standards, borrowing could become more expensive or harder to qualify for.
segments.tr: Jika bank melaporkan peningkatan gagal bayar dan standar pinjaman yang lebih ketat, peminjaman bisa menjadi lebih mahal atau lebih sulit untuk memenuhi syarat.

segments.src: If they report solid repayment and steady spending, that supports the case that the economy is on stable footing.
segments.tr: Jika mereka melaporkan pembayaran yang solid dan pengeluaran yang stabil, itu mendukung argumen bahwa ekonomi berada pada pijakan yang stabil.

segments.src: Whatever the numbers show, it is a good time for households to review their own finances: check card balances and interest rates, build an emergency fund where possible, and understand the terms of any variable-rate debt.
segments.tr: Apa pun yang ditunjukkan oleh angka-angka tersebut, ini adalah waktu yang baik bagi rumah tangga untuk meninjau keuangan mereka sendiri: memeriksa saldo kartu dan suku bunga, membangun dana darurat jika memungkinkan, dan memahami ketentuan dari utang tingkat variabel apa pun.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan Utama

segments.src: The coming bank reports will offer an early and detailed look at the state of the American consumer.
segments.tr: Laporan bank yang akan datang akan menawarkan pandangan awal dan rinci tentang keadaan konsumen Amerika.

segments.src: Investors will be searching for signs of whether households can keep up with high rates and prices.
segments.tr: Investor akan mencari tanda-tanda apakah rumah tangga dapat mengikuti suku bunga dan harga yang tinggi.

segments.src: The answers will influence expectations for the economy, for interest rates and for the earnings reports that follow from companies across the market.
segments.tr: Jawaban-jawaban tersebut akan memengaruhi ekspektasi terhadap perekonomian, suku bunga, dan laporan laba yang menyusul dari perusahaan-perusahaan di seluruh pasar.

segments.tr: *Artikel ini hanya untuk tujuan informasi umum dan bukan merupakan nasihat keuangan atau investasi.*

us-20261004-intro-logistics-1.title: [Logistik 101 #1] Pekerjaan Triliun Dolar yang Tidak Dilihat Siapa Pun: Apa Itu Logistik Sebenarnya

segments.src: > Logistics is the work of getting the right thing to the right place at the right time and cost — and in the U.S. it's roughly a $2.5 trillion-a-year industry that most people only notice when it fails.
segments.tr: > Logistik adalah pekerjaan mendapatkan hal yang tepat ke tempat yang tepat pada waktu dan biaya yang tepat — dan di A.S. ini adalah industri senilai sekitar $2,5 triliun per tahun yang sebagian besar orang hanya perhatikan ketika gagal.

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## Konsep Hari Ini

segments.src: Ask someone what logistics is and you'll usually hear "trucks."
segments.tr: Tanya kepada seseorang apa itu logistik dan Anda biasanya akan mendengar "truk."

segments.src: That's like saying finance is "ATMs."
segments.tr: Itu seperti mengatakan keuangan adalah "ATM."

segments.src: The trade association CSCMP defines logistics management as the part of supply chain management that plans, implements, and controls the efficient flow and storage of goods, services, and related information — from the point of origin to the point of consumption, and back again.
segments.tr: Asosiasi perdagangan CSCMP mendefinisikan manajemen logistik sebagai bagian dari manajemen rantai pasokan yang merencanakan, menerapkan, dan mengendalikan aliran dan penyimpanan barang, layanan, dan informasi terkait yang efisien — dari titik asal ke titik konsumsi, dan kembali lagi.

segments.src: Strip out the jargon and you get four verbs: **move, store, handle, inform.**
segments.tr: Buang istilah teknis dan Anda mendapatkan empat verba: **pindahkan, simpan, tangani, informasikan.**

segments.src: Practitioners often summarize the goal as the **seven rights**: the right product, in the right quantity, in the right condition, at the right place, at the right time, to the right customer, at the right cost.
segments.tr: Praktisi sering merangkum tujuan sebagai **tujuh hak**: produk yang tepat, dalam jumlah yang tepat, dalam kondisi yang tepat, di tempat yang tepat, pada waktu yang tepat, kepada pelanggan yang tepat, dengan biaya yang tepat.

segments.src: Notice that six of the seven are about *service* and only one is about *price*.
segments.tr: Perhatikan bahwa enam dari tujuh berkaitan dengan *layanan* dan hanya satu tentang *harga*.

segments.src: That tension is the entire discipline.
segments.tr: Ketegangan itu adalah seluruh disiplin ilmu.

segments.src: Here's the part that surprises people: logistics doesn't change what a product *is*.
segments.tr: Berikut adalah bagian yang mengejutkan orang: logistik tidak mengubah apa produk *itu*.

segments.src: A pair of running shoes sitting in a warehouse in Ohio is chemically identical to the same pair on your doorstep in Denver.
segments.tr: Sepasang sepatu lari yang ada di gudang di Ohio secara kimia identik dengan pasangan yang sama di depan pintu Anda di Denver.

segments.src: What logistics creates is **place utility** (value from being where you need it) and **time utility** (value from being there when you need it).
segments.tr: Apa yang logistik ciptakan adalah **utilitas tempat** (nilai dari berada di mana Anda membutuhkannya) dan **utilitas waktu** (nilai dari berada di sana ketika Anda membutuhkannya).

segments.src: An umbrella in a warehouse is inventory.
segments.tr: Payung di gudang adalah inventaris.

segments.src: An umbrella in a store lobby during a downpour is a sale.
segments.tr: Payung di lobi toko selama hujan deras adalah penjualan.

segments.src: **So how is this different from supply chain management?** Think of nested boxes.
segments.tr: **Jadi, bagaimana ini berbeda dari manajemen rantai pasokan?** Pikirkan kotak bersarang.

segments.src: Supply chain management (SCM) is the bigger box — it covers sourcing raw materials, negotiating with suppliers, planning production, forecasting demand, and coordinating everyone from the cotton farmer to the cashier.
segments.tr: Manajemen rantai pasokan (SCM) adalah kotak yang lebih besar — ini mencakup pengadaan bahan baku, negosiasi dengan pemasok, perencanaan produksi, peramalan permintaan, dan koordinasi semua orang dari petani kapas ke kasir.

segments.src: Logistics is the box inside it that handles physical flow and storage.
segments.tr: Logistik adalah kotak di dalamnya yang menangani aliran dan penyimpanan fisik.

segments.src: A useful shorthand:
segments.tr: Singkatan yang berguna:

segments.src: - **SCM asks:** who should make this, where, in what quantity, and on what terms?
segments.tr: - **SCM menanyakan:** siapa yang harus membuat ini, di mana, dalam jumlah berapa, dan dengan syarat apa?

segments.src: - **Logistics asks:** given those decisions, how does it physically get there, how fast, and at what cost?
segments.tr: - **Logistik menanyakan:** mengingat keputusan tersebut, bagaimana cara fisiknya sampai ke sana, seberapa cepat, dan dengan biaya berapa?

segments.src: You can't do good SCM without logistics, but logistics alone won't save you from a bad sourcing decision.
segments.tr: Anda tidak dapat melakukan SCM yang baik tanpa logistik, tetapi logistik saja tidak akan menyelamatkan Anda dari keputusan pengadaan yang buruk.

segments.src: If your supplier is 8,000 miles away and your product has a six-week shelf life, no amount of clever routing fixes that.
segments.tr: Jika pemasok Anda 8.000 mil jauhnya dan produk Anda memiliki umur simpan enam minggu, tidak ada jumlah perutean cerdas yang memperbaikinya.

segments.src: The other thing to know upfront: logistics is a **trade-off machine**, not an optimization with one answer.
segments.tr: Hal lain yang perlu diketahui: logistik adalah **mesin trade-off**, bukan optimasi dengan satu jawaban.

segments.src: Air freight is fast and expensive; ocean is cheap and slow.
segments.tr: Pengiriman udara cepat dan mahal; laut murah dan lambat.

segments.src: Holding lots of inventory means you never stock out, but the industry rule of thumb is that carrying inventory costs roughly 20–25% of its value per year in capital, warehousing, insurance, and obsolescence.
segments.tr: Menyimpan banyak inventaris berarti Anda tidak akan pernah kehabisan stok, tetapi aturan praktis industri adalah bahwa biaya membawa inventaris kira-kira 20–25% nilainya per tahun dalam modal, pergudangan, asuransi, dan keusangan.

segments.src: Five regional warehouses shorten delivery times but multiply fixed costs.
segments.tr: Lima gudang regional mempersingkat waktu pengiriman tetapi mengalikan biaya tetap.

segments.src: Every logistics decision is somebody choosing a point on a curve — usually the curve between **cost and speed**, or between **cost and reliability**.
segments.tr: Setiap keputusan logistik adalah seseorang memilih titik pada kurva — biasanya kurva antara **biaya dan kecepatan**, atau antara **biaya dan keandalan**.

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari

segments.src: You order running shoes for $89 on a Sunday night from your couch in Denver.
segments.tr: Anda memesan sepatu lari seharga $89 pada malam Minggu dari sofa Anda di Denver.

segments.src: Free two-day shipping.
segments.tr: Pengiriman gratis dua hari.

segments.src: Here's the invisible machine that runs before Tuesday.
segments.tr: Berikut adalah mesin tak terlihat yang berjalan sebelum Selasa.

segments.src: The moment you click, an inventory system decides *which* of several U.S.
segments.tr: Saat Anda mengklik, sistem inventaris memutuskan *mana* dari beberapa A.S.

segments.src: fulfillment centers should ship — not necessarily the closest one, but the one that balances distance, stock levels, and how many other Denver-bound orders it can consolidate into the same truck.
segments.tr: pusat pemenuhan harus mengirim — tidak harus yang terdekat, tetapi yang menyeimbangkan jarak, tingkat stok, dan berapa banyak pesanan Denver lainnya yang dapat dikonsolidasikan ke dalam truk yang sama.

segments.src: A worker (or increasingly, a robotic shelf-mover) picks your box, and it gets sorted onto a line-haul truck.
segments.tr: Seorang pekerja (atau semakin sering, penggerak rak robotik) mengambil kotak Anda, dan itu disortir ke truk line-haul.

segments.src: That truck may run to a sorting hub — the two most famous in the country are UPS's Worldport in Louisville, Kentucky, and FedEx's superhub in Memphis, Tennessee, both of which exist because they sit near the population-weighted center of the U.S.
segments.tr: Truk itu mungkin berjalan ke pusat sortir — dua yang paling terkenal di negara ini adalah Worldport UPS di Louisville, Kentucky, dan superhub FedEx di Memphis, Tennessee, yang keduanya ada karena mereka berada di dekat pusat tertimbang populasi A.S.

segments.src: and let packages from everywhere meet, re-sort overnight, and fly back out before dawn.
segments.tr: dan biarkan paket dari mana saja bertemu, disortir ulang semalaman, dan terbang kembali sebelum fajar.

segments.src: From there your box moves to a local delivery station, gets loaded onto a van with 150 other stops, and a route algorithm decides the driver's sequence.
segments.tr: Dari sana kotak Anda berpindah ke stasiun pengiriman lokal, dimuat ke van dengan 150 pemberhentian lainnya, dan algoritma rute memutuskan urutan pengemudi.

segments.src: That final leg — the delivery station to your door — is called the **last mile**, and it's routinely the single most expensive segment of the whole journey.
segments.tr: Leg terakhir — dari stasiun pengiriman ke pintu Anda — disebut **mil terakhir**, dan ini secara rutin merupakan segmen paling mahal dari seluruh perjalanan.

segments.src: One truck crossing Nebraska carries thousands of packages at once; one van in a Denver neighborhood carries a few hundred and burns an hour in traffic.
segments.tr: Satu truk melintasi Nebraska membawa ribuan paket sekaligus; satu van di lingkungan Denver membawa beberapa ratus dan membakar satu jam dalam lalu lintas.

segments.src: Trucking is the largest single line item in U.S.
segments.tr: Pengangkutan truk adalah item baris tunggal terbesar di A.S.

segments.src: logistics spending, and last-mile delivery is why.
segments.tr: pengeluaran logistik, dan pengiriman mil terakhir adalah alasannya.

segments.src: "Free shipping" is, of course, not free.
segments.tr: "Pengiriman gratis" tentu saja tidak gratis.

segments.src: It's priced into the $89, subsidized by your membership fee, or absorbed as a customer-acquisition cost.
segments.tr: Harganya disertakan dalam $89, disubsidi oleh biaya keanggotaan Anda, atau diserap sebagai biaya akuisisi pelanggan.

segments.src: Somebody paid for the van.
segments.tr: Seseorang membayar untuk van.

segments.src: Now zoom out.
segments.tr: Sekarang zoom out.

segments.src: Recent CSCMP *State of Logistics* reports put total U.S.
segments.tr: Laporan *State of Logistics* CSCMP terbaru menempatkan total A.S.

segments.src: business logistics costs at roughly **$2.5 trillion, or about 8–9% of GDP**.
segments.tr: biaya logistik bisnis sekitar **$2,5 triliun, atau sekitar 8–9% dari PDB**.

segments.src: That's the scale of the industry that made your Tuesday delivery unremarkable.
segments.tr: Itulah skala industri yang membuat pengiriman Selasa Anda biasa saja.

segments.src: And it's changing fast.
segments.tr: Dan itu berubah dengan cepat.

segments.src: Four trends worth knowing:
segments.tr: Empat tren yang perlu diketahui:

segments.src: 1. **E-commerce reshaped the network.** Retail logistics used to mean moving pallets to a few hundred stores. Now it means moving single boxes to millions of homes — a completely different cost structure, which is why warehouse space near cities got so valuable.
segments.tr: 1. **E-commerce membentuk ulang jaringan.** Logistik ritel biasanya berarti memindahkan palet ke beberapa ratus toko. Sekarang itu berarti memindahkan kotak tunggal ke jutaan rumah — struktur biaya yang sama sekali berbeda, itulah mengapa ruang gudang di dekat kota menjadi sangat berharga.

segments.src: 2. **Automation is filling warehouses**, driven by both labor shortages and volume — robotic picking, automated sortation, and warehouse management software.
segments.tr: 2. **Otomasi mengisi gudang**, didorong oleh kekurangan tenaga kerja dan volume — pengambilan robotik, sortasi otomatis, dan perangkat lunak manajemen gudang.

segments.src: 3. **Resilience is now a board-level word.** The 2020–2022 disruptions — port congestion, the Suez blockage, chip shortages — taught companies that the cheapest supply chain and the most reliable one are rarely the same. Hence "nearshoring," dual sourcing, and holding a bit more safety stock than pure efficiency would suggest.
segments.tr: 3. **Ketahanan sekarang adalah kata tingkat dewan.** Gangguan 2020–2022 — kemacetan pelabuhan, blokade Suez, kekurangan chip — mengajarkan perusahaan bahwa rantai pasokan termurah dan yang paling andal jarang sama. Oleh karena itu "nearshoring," dual sourcing, dan menyimpan stok keselamatan sedikit lebih banyak daripada yang akan disarankan oleh efisiensi murni.

segments.src: 4. **Visibility is the new battleground.** Knowing exactly where a shipment is, and predicting when it will actually arrive, is often worth more than shaving a few cents off the freight rate.
segments.tr: 4. **Visibilitas adalah medan pertempuran baru.** Mengetahui persis di mana pengiriman itu, dan memprediksi kapan itu akan tiba, sering kali lebih berharga daripada mengurangi beberapa sen dari tarif pengiriman.

segments.src: A last practical concept: when comparing two suppliers, the sticker price is the wrong number.
segments.tr: Konsep praktis terakhir: saat membandingkan dua pemasok, harga label adalah angka yang salah.

segments.src: What matters is **landed cost**:
segments.tr: Yang penting adalah **biaya tiba**:

segments.src: Landed cost = unit price + freight + duties/tariffs + insurance + handling
segments.tr: Landed cost = unit price + freight + duties/tariffs + insurance + handling

segments.src: A part that's 15% cheaper from overseas can easily be more expensive once it lands.
segments.tr: Suku cadang yang 15% lebih murah dari luar negeri dapat dengan mudah menjadi lebih mahal setelah tiba.

segments.src: That single line is why logistics belongs in strategy meetings and not just in the loading dock.
segments.tr: Baris tunggal itu adalah mengapa logistik memiliki tempat di pertemuan strategi dan bukan hanya di loading dock.

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## Ringkasan 3 Baris

segments.src: 1. Logistics is the move-store-handle-inform work that creates **place and time utility** — it doesn't change the product, it changes where and when it's available.
segments.tr: 1. Logistik adalah pekerjaan pindah-simpan-tangani-informasikan yang menciptakan **utilitas tempat dan waktu** — itu tidak mengubah produk, itu mengubah di mana dan kapan produk tersedia.

segments.src: 2. Logistics is a **subset of supply chain management**: SCM decides who makes what, where, and how much; logistics executes the physical flow and storage.
segments.tr: 2. Logistik adalah **bagian dari manajemen rantai pasokan**: SCM memutuskan siapa membuat apa, di mana, dan berapa banyak; logistik mengeksekusi aliran dan penyimpanan fisik.

segments.src: 3. Every logistics decision is a **trade-off** among cost, speed, and reliability — and the honest number to compare is landed cost, not sticker price.
segments.tr: 3. Setiap keputusan logistik adalah **trade-off** antara biaya, kecepatan, dan keandalan — dan angka jujur untuk dibandingkan adalah biaya tiba, bukan harga label.

segments.src: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈
segments.tr: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri

segments.src: **1.** Which statement best describes the relationship between logistics and supply chain management?
segments.tr: **1.** Pernyataan mana yang paling baik menggambarkan hubungan antara logistik dan manajemen rantai pasokan?

segments.src: - (A) They are two words for exactly the same thing.
segments.tr: - (A) Mereka adalah dua kata untuk hal yang persis sama.

segments.src: - (B) Logistics is a component of supply chain management, focused on physical flow and storage.
segments.tr: - (B) Logistik adalah komponen manajemen rantai pasokan, berfokus pada aliran dan penyimpanan fisik.

segments.src: - (C) Supply chain management is a component of logistics.
segments.tr: - (C) Manajemen rantai pasokan adalah komponen logistik.

segments.src: - (D) Logistics covers strategy; supply chain management covers trucks.
segments.tr: - (D) Logistik mencakup strategi; manajemen rantai pasokan mencakup truk.

segments.src: **2.** In a typical parcel delivery, which leg is usually the most expensive per package?
segments.tr: **2.** Dalam pengiriman paket biasa, leg mana yang biasanya paling mahal per paket?

segments.src: - (A) The ocean crossing
segments.tr: - (A) Penyeberangan laut

segments.src: - (B) The long-haul truck between hubs
segments.tr: - (B) Truk jarak jauh antara hub

segments.src: - (C) The last mile, from local station to the customer's door
segments.tr: - (C) Mil terakhir, dari stasiun lokal ke pintu pelanggan

segments.src: - (D) The initial pick-and-pack in the warehouse
segments.tr: - (D) Pengambilan dan pengepakan awal di gudang

segments.src: **3.** (O/X) Because logistics doesn't physically alter a product, it doesn't add real economic value.
segments.tr: **3.** (O/X) Karena logistik tidak secara fisik mengubah produk, itu tidak menambah nilai ekonomi nyata.

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini

segments.src: - **Logistics** — Planning and controlling the efficient flow and storage of goods, services, and related information from origin to consumption, including returns.
segments.tr: - **Logistik** — Perencanaan dan pengendalian aliran dan penyimpanan barang, layanan, dan informasi terkait yang efisien dari asal ke konsumsi, termasuk pengembalian.

segments.src: - **Supply Chain Management (SCM)** — The broader coordination of sourcing, production, planning, and distribution across all partners from raw material to end customer; logistics sits inside it.
segments.tr: - **Manajemen Rantai Pasokan (SCM)** — Koordinasi yang lebih luas dari pengadaan, produksi, perencanaan, dan distribusi di semua mitra dari bahan baku hingga pelanggan akhir; logistik berada di dalamnya.

segments.src: - **Last mile** — The final delivery leg from a local facility to the customer's door; typically the most expensive segment per package.
segments.tr: - **Mil terakhir** — Leg pengiriman terakhir dari fasilitas lokal ke pintu pelanggan; biasanya segmen paling mahal per paket.

segments.src: - **Lead time** — Total elapsed time from placing an order to receiving it; the number customers actually feel.
segments.tr: - **Waktu tunggu** — Total waktu yang berlalu dari penempatan pesanan hingga menerimanya; angka yang benar-benar dirasakan pelanggan.

segments.src: - **Landed cost** — The all-in cost of getting a purchased item to your door: unit price plus freight, duties, insurance, and handling.
segments.tr: - **Biaya tiba** — Biaya all-in untuk mendapatkan item yang dibeli ke pintu Anda: harga unit plus pengiriman, bea, asuransi, dan penanganan.

segments.src: - **3PL (third-party logistics)** — An outside company hired to run warehousing, transportation, or fulfillment on your behalf instead of doing it in-house.
segments.tr: - **3PL (logistik pihak ketiga)** — Perusahaan luar yang disewa untuk menjalankan pergudangan, transportasi, atau pemenuhan atas nama Anda daripada melakukannya secara internal.
*Jawaban: 1 → (B).

segments.src: Logistics is the physical-flow-and-storage piece nested inside the wider SCM function, which also covers sourcing, demand planning, and supplier strategy.
segments.tr: Logistik adalah bagian aliran fisik dan penyimpanan yang bersarang di dalam fungsi SCM yang lebih luas, yang juga mencakup pengadaan, perencanaan permintaan, dan strategi pemasok.

segments.src: Long-haul legs spread their cost across thousands of packages; a delivery van covers far fewer stops per hour, so the last mile carries a disproportionate share of total delivery cost.
segments.tr: Legs jarak jauh menyebarkan biaya mereka di ribuan paket; van pengiriman mencakup pemberhentian jauh lebih sedikit per jam, jadi mil terakhir membawa bagian yang tidak proporsional dari total biaya pengiriman.

segments.src: | 3 → X (False).
segments.tr: | 3 → X (Salah).

segments.src: Logistics creates place utility and time utility — an umbrella in a warehouse and an umbrella in a store lobby during a downpour are the same object with very different economic value.*
segments.tr: Logistik menciptakan utilitas tempat dan utilitas waktu — payung di gudang dan payung di lobi toko selama hujan deras adalah objek yang sama dengan nilai ekonomi yang sangat berbeda.*
